rules.point_elevation_rule: Elevation inside primary_location/geo.points belongs only to that GPS point (entrance, pier, trailhead, viewpoint, etc.) and never satisfies object-level elevation QA by itself.
rules.object_elevation_rule: geo.object_elevation describes the object itself above mean sea level: summit/highest point for peaks, min/max or characteristic elevation for extensive terrain, water_surface for lakes, and site elevation for point-like cultural objects.
rules.elevation_range_rule: Use min_m/max_m for mountains, plateaus, parks and other extensive objects when one scalar would create false precision.
rules.large_objects: Use an operational primary point such as entrance/trailhead/pier and additional geo.points rather than an unexplained geometric centre.
